# teams_calling_line_identity (Data Source)

Look up an existing CallingLineIdentity object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `block_incoming_pstn_caller_id` (Boolean) Maps to the -BlockIncomingPstnCallerID parameter.
- `calling_id_substitute` (String) Maps to the -CallingIDSubstitute parameter.
- `company_name` (String) Maps to the -CompanyName parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `enable_user_override` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableUserOverride parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `resource_account` (String) Maps to the -ResourceAccount parameter.
- `service_number` (String) Maps to the -ServiceNumber parameter.
